channel.title: Coastal Eventures: upcoming events
channel.description: The next 40 dated events on the Gulf Coast.

item.title: 18th Annual Baytowne Wharf Beer Festival (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Fri 10/16 · 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM (Backyard Bash) · Sat 10/17 · 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM (Grand Tasting) | Baytowne Wharf Events Plaza | from $45. The 18th annual festival runs a Friday tailgate-style Backyard Bash followed by Saturday's grand craft-beer tasting, both with live music and food. The festival's own pages describe the beer lineup as either over 100 or 150+ craft beers depending on which page you read, and admission is 21+ for the tasting though the Village around it stays open to everyone.

item.title: 2026 USTA Alabama Junior Open (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Sat 10/17 – Sun 10/18 · times not yet published | Mobile Tennis Center | No published price. A statewide junior tennis tournament brings about 200 young players to the Mobile Tennis Center for a two-day weekend. As with the facility's other USTA events this fall, the host page does not publish match times.

item.title: 2026 Walton County Fair (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Monday 10/12 to Saturday 10/17 · gates 5:00 PM (Saturday noon) · final tickets sold at 9:00 PM | Walton County Fairgrounds | from $5. The Walton County Fair runs Monday, October 12 through Saturday, October 17 at the fairgrounds in DeFuniak Springs, with its tagline Rooted in Tradition, Built for the Future. The week has a carnival midway with new rides, the famous pig show and outdoor concerts on Friday and Saturday nights, plus vendor and food booths and food trucks. Gates open at 5:00 PM, or noon on Saturday, and the final tickets are sold at 9:00 PM each night.

item.title: 38th Annual Jubilee Festival of Arts (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Saturday 10/17 · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM · Sunday 10/18 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM | W.O. Lott Park | Free. Olde Towne Daphne fills with more than one hundred local and regional artists showing handmade jewelry, paintings, pottery, sculpture, wood and mixed media work along the Eastern Shore of Mobile Bay. The festival also runs a kids art park and a food court alongside the market vendors.

item.title: Animal Adoption Day at Historic Blakeley State Park (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Saturday 10/17 · during park hours | Historic Blakeley State Park | from $3. Historic Blakeley State Park teams up with the Baldwin Humane Society for an adoption day in the park. The park lists the event as complimentary with regular park admission. Coco Nutty's ice cream and frozen treat truck is also listed at the park that day.

item.title: Blithe Spirit: Theatre 98 (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Weekends 10/16-11/1/2026 · eves + matinees | Theatre 98, Fairhope | from $20. Noël Coward's classic ghost-comedy plays at Fairhope's intimate community playhouse, a witty, dressed-up date in Fairhope.

item.title: CCB Lobster Fest, Round 2 (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Fri 10/16 to Sun 10/18 (moved from 10/9 to 10/11 for the weather) | Coastal County Brewing Company | No published price. Coastal County Brewing Company brings Lobster Fest back for a second round from October 9 to 11. The brewery lists Friday starting at 5:00 PM and Saturday and Sunday from 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM. The event is at the brewery on E Olive Rd in Pensacola.

item.title: Fall Ball at Blue Wahoos Stadium: Alabama vs. Georgia Tech (fall baseball exhibition) (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Saturday 10/17 · start time not posted | Blue Wahoos Stadium | No published price. Fall Ball: Alabama vs. Georgia Tech is a college baseball scrimmage at the Blue Wahoos' downtown ballpark on Saturday, October 17. It's one of three fall exhibitions in what the club calls its largest-ever fall schedule. Tickets are sold through bluewahoos.com.

item.title: Game Days at Marina Bar & Grill (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Thursday 10/1 | Marina Bar & Grill, Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort | No published price. Marina Bar & Grill at Baytowne Marina runs its own Game Days program, showing NCAA football on Saturdays and NFL games on Sundays plus select Monday and Thursday nights. It sits right on the marina at Sandestin.

item.title: Hermit Crab Races at CRABS on the Beach (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Saturdays 10/10 and 10/17 · 5:00 PM and 6:00 PM | CRABS on the Beach | Free. CRABS on the Beach races purple pincher hermit crabs in its playground on Saturday, October 10 and Saturday, October 17, with races at 5:00 PM and 6:00 PM. The restaurant says it has run the races free of charge for smaller guests for 23 years. The crabs are native to Honduras and Chile and live in trees near the ocean.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Tuesday 9/15 | West Regional Library | No published price. West Regional Library hosts this youth exhibition tied to the Jazz Art Writers South Festival, a partnership between Mobile Arts Council and Amp Up Arts. More than 50 paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 line the space, each interpreting jazz through color and line. No viewing hours are published for Tuesday, September 15, so call the library to confirm.

item.title: Jo Koy: Koy Meets World Tour (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Saturday 10/17 · 8:00 PM (doors 7:00 PM) | Saenger Theatre Mobile | No published price. Jo Koy brings his stand-up act to the Saenger Theatre in downtown Mobile for one show, with doors at 7:00 PM ahead of an 8:00 PM start. The venue's own event page does not publish an end time or any age guidance for the show.

item.title: Make Your Own Glass (hot glass, by appointment) (SAT 10/17)
item.description: By appointment: Wednesdays 5 PM-9 PM, Saturdays 8 AM-11 AM | First City Art Center | from $85. Make Your Own Glass is a hands-on hot glass session at First City Art Center in Pensacola, where each participant makes a piece with a glassblower. It's for ages 8 and up including adults, by appointment on Wednesdays from 5-9 PM and Saturdays from 8-11 AM. The finished piece cools in an annealing oven and is picked up the following week. Standard pieces cost $85, and premium pieces such as a pumpkin, ornament, cup or bowl cost $110-$140.

item.title: MONOCHROME exhibition (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Sunday 9/27 to Saturday 10/24 · times not posted | Blue Morning Gallery | No published price. Monochrome is a group show by three artists at Blue Morning Gallery, 21 S. Palafox Place in downtown Pensacola, running through Saturday, October 24. The black-and-white work asks what you notice, such as shadow angles, line curves and surface grain. The First Friday reception was October 2 and has passed.

item.title: Painting with a Twist Pensacola: paint-and-sip, family paint days and date nights (weekly programme) (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Classes most days: family days Saturday 10:30 AM, brunch Sunday 11 AM, evenings Wednesday to Saturday | Painting with a Twist Pensacola | $35 per family. Painting with a Twist Pensacola is an artist-led paint-and-sip studio at 4771 Bayou Blvd Suite C11 with several classes every week. October has family paint days (ages 6 and up with a parent, no alcohol), adult Paint & Sip and Date Night classes (ages 16 and up on date nights), Halloween-themed canvases and Paint Your Pet. Classes cost $35-$60 depending on the class, and alcohol is sold on site with no BYOB.

item.title: Pink Pirate's 5K for Breast Cancer (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Saturday 10/17 · Packet pickup 7:00 AM · Run/walk starts 8:00 AM | Navarre Beach Boat Launch Parking Lot | from $25. Navarre Pink Pirates runs its 12th annual 5K run/walk along Navarre Beach to raise money for mammograms. The course heads west from the Boat Launch lot and back. Active.com's registration lists $25 for run or walk, $30 day-of, and the organizer's own site confirms the October 17 date. The first 200 registered participants get a T-shirt, with an advance packet pickup the day before at the Chamber office.

item.title: Pokémon League at GameMasters Guild (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Thursdays 3 PM-8 PM and Saturdays 12 PM-2 PM | GameMasters Guild | Free. Pokémon League at GameMasters Guild is free casual play for the Pokémon TCG, the Pokémon Champions video game and Pokémon GO. It runs Thursdays from 3 to 8 PM and Saturdays from 12 to 2 PM in Crestview. All ages are welcome, and the shop calls it a family-friendly space. Players get promo cards or special items while supplies last, and a free Pokémon account is needed to qualify (children under 13 register under a parent's account).

item.title: Primal Fear Haunted Attraction at OWA (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Select nights through October 31 · evenings | OWA Parks & Resort | No published price. OWA's immersive haunted attraction runs on select nights through the end of October, with dates including September 25 to 26 and October 2 to 3, 9 to 10, 16 to 17 and 19 to 31. A $7 Zombie Laser Tag add-on is available alongside the main attraction, and tickets are required.

item.title: Public Ice Skating at the Pensacola Bay Center (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Oct 17 to Oct 30 · one hour sessions, see dates | Pensacola Bay Center | from $15. The Pensacola Bay Center opens its ice for one-hour public skate sessions from October through April. The first sessions in this window run Saturday 10/17 at 9:30 PM, Sunday 10/18 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, Saturday 10/24 at 9:30 PM, Sunday 10/25 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, and Friday 10/30 at 9:30 PM. Capacity is limited for each session, so buy tickets early.

item.title: Pumpkin Decorating Contest at Niceville Library (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Entries through Saturday 10/17 · voting Monday 10/19 to Saturday 10/24 · winners Tuesday 10/27 | Niceville Library | No published price. Niceville Library runs a pumpkin decorating contest for ages 13 and older. Entrants drop off a decorated pumpkin with a completed entry form during library hours through Saturday, October 17, and visitors vote for a favorite from October 19 to 24. The top three pumpkins win prizes announced on October 27, and entrants collect their pumpkins by 2:00 PM on October 31.

item.title: Shrimp Boil and Beach Bonfire at Seascape Resort (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Saturday 10/17 | Seascape Resort | No published price. Seascape Resort's own events page lists a beach shrimp boil paired with a bonfire, without stating an exact time. Confirm the schedule with the resort before making the drive.

item.title: Smokin' in the Square BBQ Cookoff (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Saturday 10/17 | St. Sylvester Catholic Church | No published price. Smokin' in the Square is a barbecue cookoff at St. Sylvester Catholic Church on Saturday, October 17.

item.title: Sweet Dreams Haunted Attraction (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Fridays 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM · Saturdays 7:00 PM to 11:00 PM · Sundays 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM through 11/1 | Sweet Dreams Haunted Attraction | from $25. Sweet Dreams Haunted Attraction runs an indoor haunted house at 811 St Francis St in downtown Mobile on Friday, Saturday and Sunday nights through Sunday, November 1. Guests walk through dark mazes with live scare actors, and optional Blackout and Chamber mini escape games cost extra. The attraction warns it may be too intense for younger children, and every child must be accompanied by an adult.

item.title: Teen Dungeons and Dragons at Moorer (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Saturdays 11:30 AM to 1:30 PM · Tuesdays 4:00 PM to 6:00 PM | Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library | No published price. The Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library runs a tabletop Dungeons & Dragons adventure for teens ages 12 to 18. Registration is recommended, and upcoming sessions include Tuesday, October 6, Saturday, October 17, and Tuesday, October 20.

item.title: The 39 Steps: Hitchcock Farce (ECTC) (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Oct 15-25 · Thu-Sat 7 PM · Sun 2 PM · Wed 1 PM · Thu 10/22 also 1 PM | Emerald Coast Theatre Company | No published price. Four actors play 150 roles in a full-tilt Hitchcock spoof that is clean, fast, and laugh-out-loud. It is the safe-bet theatre date of the fall.

item.title: UWF Football vs West Alabama: HOMECOMING (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Saturday 10/17 · 1:00 PM kickoff (moved from 4 PM) · gates open 12 PM | PenAir Field | No published price. University of West Florida football closes out its Homecoming weekend against West Alabama at PenAir Field, in the program's first NCAA Division I season. Tickets are on sale. UWF students attend free with registration on Argo Pulse and a Student Nautilus Card.

item.title: Wanda Sullivan: Bloem Exhibition (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Now through December 11 | Anna Lamar Switzer Center for Visual Arts | No published price. A gallery exhibition by artist Wanda Sullivan runs at Pensacola State College's visual arts center through mid-December. The center's own site does not publish an admission price.

item.title: Steve's 13th Catfish Tournament (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Saturday 10/17 · 7:00 AM to 1:00 PM | Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm | from $50. Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm in Walnut Hill holds its 13th catfish tournament on Saturday, October 17 from 7:00 AM to 1:00 PM. Anglers fish two marked ponds with rod and reel only, and the single heaviest fish wins a cash prize split 60, 25 and 15 percent among the top three. Men's and women's brackets award gift cards and farm merchandise.

item.title: Chappie James Bridge Run (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Saturday 10/17 · 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM | Visitor Welcome Center, Pensacola Bay Bridge route to Gulf Breeze | from $54.98. This 5K run or walk crosses the three-mile Pensacola Bay Bridge from Pensacola into Gulf Breeze and finishes next to The Bridge Bar and Sunset Lounge, with a post-race party of food, refreshments and live music. Buses run back to Pensacola, with the last one leaving Gulf Breeze at 10 AM.

item.title: Fall Market in the Park (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Saturdays 10/17 to 11/14 · 7:30 AM to 12:00 PM | Cathedral Square | No published price. The City of Mobile runs Fall Market in the Park every Saturday morning from October 17 through November 14 in Cathedral Square. Farmers, artisans and food vendors sell seasonal produce, seafood, baked goods and art, and live entertainment plays in the park while you shop. Vendors accept Senior Farmer's Market Nutritional Program benefits, and leashed pets are welcome.

item.title: Ride MORE Bicycles Saturday Shop Ride (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Saturdays · 7:30 AM | Ride MORE Bicycles | No published price. The Ride MORE Bicycles Saturday Shop Ride is a weekly road group ride that leaves the shop at 59 E Gregory St. in Pensacola. It covers about 30 miles at a 17-19 mph average, with sprints and regrouping spots. The ride runs 7:30-9:30 AM every Saturday and road bikes are required.

item.title: 2026 Bud Light Charity Challenge (tennis) (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Friday 10/16 to Saturday 10/17 · 8:00 AM | Roger Scott Tennis Complex | $15 for two. The 2026 Bud Light Charity Challenge is a two-day adult doubles tennis tournament at the Roger Scott Tennis Complex in Pensacola. It benefits The Arc Gateway and Pensacola Sports. Family and friends can attend with a guest pass picked up at check-in.

item.title: The Great Bellingrath Harvest (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Daily through 11/8 · 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM | Bellingrath Gardens and Home | from $11. Bellingrath Gardens and Home runs a fall festival from September 19 through November 8 with seasonal displays across the gardens, including the scarecrow exhibit and pumpkin displays. The gardens are open daily, and the general admission price applies. The events page does not list a separate price for the harvest, so the gardens ticket is the number to plan with.

item.title: Adventure Zone at Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Mon-Sat through Oct 31 · 9 AM to 6 PM | Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm | No published price. Steve's Farm has rebranded as Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm and opened a fall attraction in Walnut Hill with a corn maze, a giant slide, a kids' zipline, a jump pad, hayrides, a wagon train, a sunflower field and a pumpkin patch. It suits a family with small children who want a half day outdoors. The farm's own page does not print admission prices, so check the ticket page before driving out.

item.title: Back to School "Rock Painting Party" (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Saturday 10/17 · 9-11 AM | Capt. Royal Melvin Heritage Park (Harbor Front) | from $3. An outdoor rock-painting session at the harbor-front park comes with snacks. Rocks, paint and brushes are supplied, or bring your own rocks to paint. Pre-registration is required since space is limited.

item.title: Big Rigs at the Library: Touch-a-Truck in Foley (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Saturday 10/17 · 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM | Foley Recreation Department Activity Center lawn | Free. The Foley Community Library hosts its third Touch-a-Truck, where children climb around tractors, backhoes, bucket trucks and other big machines. Foley's fire, police, public works and street departments bring vehicles, and Maynard Family Farms brings a petting zoo. A local musician plays live, and Kona Ice and ReNew Coffee Truck sell treats and drinks.

item.title: BOO at the ZOO at the Alabama Gulf Coast Zoo (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Saturday 10/17 · 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM | Alabama Gulf Coast Zoo | from $15.95. The Alabama Gulf Coast Zoo hosts a scare-free morning of trick or treating along the zoo paths. The zoo says the event is included with regular admission. Families should bring their own treat bags.

item.title: Emerald Coast Fall Classic Beach Volleyball (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Wednesday 10/14 to Sunday 10/18 · 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM daily | The Boardwalk on Okaloosa Island | No published price. Beach volleyball teams play doubles and the Fudpucker four-player tournament on the sand at the Boardwalk on Okaloosa Island. Play runs 9:00 AM to 4:00 PM each day. The Men and Women pool play is Saturday, and playoffs and finals are Sunday, with the Women's Open final around 3:00 PM and a costume contest at 3:45 PM. The schedule is tentative, so check the tournament page before driving.

item.title: Fall Book Carnival at Grand Boulevard (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Saturday 10/17 · 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM | Grand Boulevard at Sandestin | No published price. The Fall Book Carnival takes over Grand Boulevard at Sandestin on Saturday, October 17, from 9 AM to 1 PM. Kids can pick up free books, work through hands on crafts, and listen to live music while families take part in the carnival's other activities.

item.title: Fall Into Family History at Santa Rosa County Libraries (SAT 10/17)
item.description: Wednesday 10/7 Pace · Wednesday 10/14 Jay · Wednesday 10/21 Gulf Breeze · Wednesday 10/28 Navarre · 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM | Santa Rosa County libraries: Pace, Jay, Gulf Breeze and Navarre | No published price. The library system's lead reference specialist visits one branch each Wednesday in October to help people start or extend a family tree. Visitors can bring a specific research question or simply stop by to learn how to get started with the library's genealogy resources. The help runs during regular library hours, so no appointment time is listed.
